name: SpeedRead: EPUB & PDF
subtitle: Read at your own pace
promotionalText: Full local reading is free for up to 3 books. Pro adds unlimited books and private iCloud sync.
description:
SpeedRead is a private, local-first EPUB and PDF reader for iPhone and iPad.

Import up to three DRM-free books for free and use the complete local experience: customizable regular reading, contextual RSVP Speed mode, on-device PDF OCR, progress, status, tags, search, and sharing. Your local library remains available offline.

SpeedRead Pro adds an unlimited library and private iCloud synchronization through monthly, annual, or lifetime access. Existing books remain readable, shareable, and removable if Pro access expires.

Speed mode keeps nearby words visible, anchors the active word at its optimal recognition point, and supports adaptive pacing from 100 to 1000 WPM. PDF text extraction and OCR run on-device; OCR results and derived PDF data remain local.
reviewNotes: SpeedRead requires no custom account. Free access supports up to three imported books with all local features, including Speed mode and on-device PDF OCR. Tap the Library crown or reach the fourth unique import to open SpeedRead Pro. Monthly com.sild.speedread.pro.monthly, annual com.sild.speedread.pro.annual, and lifetime com.sild.speedread.pro.lifetime all unlock unlimited books and private iCloud sync. Restore Purchases is visible; active subscribers can open Manage Subscription. Tap Import or open a DRM-free EPUB or password-free PDF from Files. Protected EPUBs and password-locked PDFs are rejected. With Pro, original EPUB/PDF files and library state synchronize through the reviewer's private iCloud account; OCR results and derived PDF data remain local. Rights-cleared fixtures can be attached if requested.
